claim: Faceclaw prepares iOS TestFlight beta for Even G2 companion interoperability
summary: October 11 UTC GitHub commits prepare Faceclaw 0.8.3-rc1 TestFlight beta and public signup, add iOS pairing-screen improvements and ANCS notification category icons. These are commits on the project repository, not evidence that the TestFlight build has shipped or that GlassesResearch tested the iOS client. As of discovery, the latest published GitHub release was 0.8.2 (October 4). Hold release-availability claims pending an actual TestFlight distribution or published release.
